item.title: From Mud Walls To Modern Marvels: 6 Indian Women Architects Who Transformed Our Built Environment
item.description: Besides foundational structures, these women architects have also built solid social structures to inspire more women in the future.

item.title: Will Conservative Feminism Not Ruin Everything? And Is It The Latest Trick In The ‘Patriarchy Playbook’
item.description: The core belief that Conservative feminism holds is that men and women are different and thereby can never be equal.

item.title: The Emotional Politics Of Digital Masculinity
item.description: Explore the concept of digital masculinity and how online platforms shape modern male identities and behaviours.

item.title: Too Good To Be True?: Fact Checking DIY Menstrual Masks
item.description: Evidence from dermatology credits zero points to the benefits of menstrual masking and reiterates the potential harm in using menstrual blood as a healing face mask.

item.title: Is Trauma Dumping A New Label For Women's Emotional Expression Online?
item.description: When a woman opens up about a bad relationship or work stress or anything stressful, people readily accuse her of ‘trauma dumping’.

item.title: The Region And Its Icons: The Various Contradictions Of Hindutva Nation-Building In Bengal
item.description: While an insult to culture might have wounded the Bhadralok Bengali, the BJP's recent attacks have affected the Dalit and Muslim working classes of Bengal most.

item.title: From Rishta To Risk: Scams And AI Morphing Fueling Gendered Violence On Indian Matrimonial Sites
item.description: In India, matrimonial apps – for caste or region specific – have now become interwoven in the very fabric of the marriage marketplace.

item.title: This World AIDS Day, Learn About India’s First PrEP/PEP Locator
item.description: Explore the challenges surrounding AIDS and healthcare in India. Awareness and access remain limited for vulnerable populations.

item.title: On The Future Of Queer Comedy In India: In Conversation With Aayushi Jagad
item.description: In this exclusive interview, Queer-Rated Comedy's Aayushi Jagad performs her piece about her relationship with bisexuality and discusses her career at Pune's Comedy Clubhouse.

item.title: Humans In The Loop Review: Adivasi Women's Labor In AI Training And Quiet Rebellion Of Mothers
item.description: Humans in the Loop is not a film about technology; it is a tender, fierce portrait of the human hands that make intelligence possible.
